This is a SEED. Grow it to ~100 entries from the live warehouse (run
`pipeline nlp spans --limit N`, read the chunks, correct the spans) before
using the numbers to judge a GLiNER model or threshold change. The stub
extractor only covers the dictionary-backed labels, so its recall on
LOCATION / PROGRAMME / novel provider names is expected to be low.

entries.text: Change Grow Live delivers opioid substitution treatment and needle exchange for the adult drug and alcohol service.
Recovery workers and non-medical prescribers are hard to recruit; methadone and buprenorphine prescribing continues across every team.
Turning Point holds the contract, commissioned by the local authority public health team with support from the integrated care board.
The alcohol care team at the hospital referred patients with alcohol dependence to residential rehabilitation.
